_about: Files where one mistake can break every game, Checkpoint or the CI. A change to any of them gets an independent ChatGPT review before Kody says 'push it'. See tools/review/README.md.

paths.games/scorecode.js: score codes and saved-run expiry: codes must still decode for every game id, old codes keep working, ids never reused
paths.games/catalog.js: hub list and UNLOCK dates: a game must not unlock early or vanish; NEW badges
paths.games/kit.js: shared game kit (sound, keys, fullscreen, reduce-motion, end screen): every game loads it
paths.games/questions.js: question sets: right answers must be right, every set must still generate, set order is fixed
paths.games/sw.js: service worker: a bad cache can serve students stale or broken games
paths.checkpoint/player.html: the Checkpoint test player students take tests in
paths..github/workflows/: CI: permissions, triggers, secrets, untrusted PR code
paths.tools/qa/lib/: the shared gameplay test runner: tests that pass while a game is broken (false greens)
paths..claude/settings.json: what Claude sessions may run or push
paths.tools/qa/readability.js: readability check in the Safety check: false greens (problems it can't see), or false reds that block every PR
paths.tools/qa/readability-baseline.json: known readability problems: adding entries hides new problems
paths..github/smoke/: the Safety check: false greens let broken pages reach students
